title: Otori Emu — Our Feelings Become One〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice weather, so much sun♪ Sunny sunny fun fun☆

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Hello, Emu!
As energetic as ever, I see!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: Let's give it our best today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: You seem awfully happy, Ms. Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's because it feels like we can all talk to each other again♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was so busy with Wonder Stage stuff that I didn't have any time to talk to anyone at the other stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After a while, it felt like there was this really big wall between us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But now that's gone and we can talk to each other whenever we want! It's so much more fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Um, Mr. Mascot...?
There's something I need to tell you too...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Ms. Emu. I have other duties to attend to, so if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What? You're not gonna stay and watch us practice?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Your next show does not include me so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know...
But I really need to tell you this...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I will be there at a moment's notice when you do need me. For now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait...!
Mr. Mascot...!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, there you are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're late, Emu...!
Where were you all this time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is she okay? She's just staring into nothingness...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Wait, Emu! If you keep walking you'll...!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I tried to warn you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Hehe. My nose almost got squished there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, because you weren't paying attention to where you were going.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Um...
Well, I might be getting the wrong idea but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You think the mascots are avoiding you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. They hasn't been around lately to help us practice and stuff, and even keep saying that there's something they have to go take care of...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, they haven't been around here in quite some time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, they usually didn't show themselves unless we were practicing or rehearsing. Only then would a few stand ready by the stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, they're all Emu's bodyguards, right? Why would they be avoiding her of all people?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I... We, the mascots, are under the employ of Ms. Emu's father...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: So we are not in the position to support her ideas as such...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: As much as we'd like to be more sympathetic to her ideas, we are unfortunately in no position to do so.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: But you were able to cross that line... You were able to overcome that hurdle...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Understandably, the mascots were in no position to actually help Emu in any way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. That explains this awkward rift that stands between them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: Then, just after everyone from the Wonder Stage came to talk to us, Poochie was right behind them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All I want to do is thank Mr. Mascot and his friends...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe we can help...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
(Another quiet day.
I should be getting back to the Wonder Stage soon...)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Wait, was that...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Mr. Mascot! Help me!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: No...! What are they all doing on the ground...?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu! Are you alright, Ms. Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm completely fine♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Haha! Now, get him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: G-Gotcha!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: W-What is the meaning of this...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's something that Emu's been desperately trying to tell you, so we decided to put on a little skit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mr. Mascot...
Why have you been avoiding me?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it because of what I've been trying to do? Is that why you haven't really been talking to me?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: No, you're misunderstanding...!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
I...
We wanted to help you...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: But all we could do was be by your side.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Be it for Project Wonder, for when the Wonder Stage was in danger of being scrapped, there was nothing we could do to help...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's not true...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't you remember when we decided to keep the Wonder Stage going? It was just us back then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'd tell everyone that a show as about to start, but nobody would come to see it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even the next day and the next and the next, nobody came to watch... But you guys all kept helping me with my shows...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I knew that helping me do shows like that isn't what you're supposed to be doing, but I kept asking for your help...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it's also why I was able to keep going! I never gave up on my shows or this stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It made me feel so much better knowing that I'd have all of you there with me...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: We are also glad that we are tasked with being by your side.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Does that mean you'll keep doing shows with us?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes, of course. As long as that is your wish.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It is...!
Thank you so much, Mr. Mascot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I want to thank all the other mascots too!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Understood.
I will have them all gather after the park closes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay! Thanks, Mr. Mascot!
I love you so much♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: M-Ms. Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good for you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. I should be thanking you guys too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. This was nothing. After all, we do owe the mascots quite a lot for what they've done.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, enough with this detour.
How about we start practice now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm super duper ready!
Hehe...
